# Comprehension test sources

These handwritten pairs exercise ordinary prose without prescribed heading names,
arrow syntax, or a domain-specific template. Each JSON fixture records a reader
question, an authored answer, exact source excerpts, and the visible conditions
or policy states that must survive rendering. The workflow pairs require a
conditional flow; the policy pairs require a current/proposed comparison.

Automated assertions verify that those authored answers and conditions are
reachable in the rendered explanation before the source library. They do not
establish semantic correctness or prove that a human reader understands them;
independent source review and rendered reading review remain necessary.
